holderQuote: The Champion of Rhir. Sir Richard rode at the gap as the [Hydromancer] peeled off from the Humans and their escort of elite [Soldiers]. She raised a staff and pointed.
effectQuote: Then Richard hit the first demons on the ground. He swung a massive sword like it weighed nothing.

holderQuote: Richard pointed. Some half-Elf he thought he knew was pointing a wand at them
